caption: The drawing displays a single, large bell positioned centrally on the page. The bell is rendered in color and exhibits a mottled texture with shades of brown, gold, yellow, and hints of blue and purple, giving it a metallic and slightly tarnished appearance. The shape of the bell is flared at the bottom and more narrow at the top, with a smooth curved edge. Above and to the sides of the bell is the faint outline of a mounting bracket or yoke, which appears to be sketched lightly in pencil and remains uncolored, with some details of bolts or fasteners visible. The background is plain, with no other objects or decorations, and the paper is an off-white shade.
title: Bell
